prompts.base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent UAE country map base for a hand-made travel scrapbook. Image 1 is the exact outline and composition guide; keep its 1350 by 1000 canvas aspect ratio, country silhouette position and scale, all coastlines, islands and border geometry aligned exactly. Image 2 is a STYLE reference only. Repaint the sand shape of image 1 with delicate imperfect hand-drawn umber edges, broad muted sand and warm ochre acrylic areas, visible dry brush grain inside the paint, a few subtle desert dune brush marks in the south, a few minimal grey-brown mountain strokes in the northeast. Restrained 4-color palette. Actual transparent RGBA everywhere outside the UAE silhouette, including Oman and the sea. Keep the whole map, not a bottom-half vignette. No white paper background, no checkerboard, no country title, no labels, no borders between emirates, no roads, no arrows, no landmarks or city icons. The markers will be separate assets.

prompts.ending: Use case: stylized-concept. One delicate minimalist hand-painted travel scrapbook footer scene for the United Arab Emirates. A small quiet landscape vignette centered within a 3:2 canvas, with generous transparent negative space around it. Match the input style reference: slightly imperfect hand-drawn dark lines, only four restrained flat acrylic pigments of ochre, sand, slate blue and muted turquoise, visible dry-brush marks and paper grain INSIDE the shapes, organic edges.
